# Nguyen Tran Anh Khoa - Software Engineer & Fullstack Developer

> Official portfolio and curriculum vitae of Nguyen Tran Anh Khoa (KhoaSinno).

- **Full Name**: Nguyen Tran Anh Khoa
- **Role**: Software Engineer / Fullstack Developer / AI Systems
- **Location**: Can Tho City, Vietnam
- **Education**: Can Tho University of Technology (Information Technology)
- **Domain**: https://www.nguyentrananhkhoa.id.vn
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/KhoaSinno

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, State Management.
- **Backend & Database**: FastAPI, Python, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma, Redis.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Riverpod, Android, iOS.
- **AI & Integrations**: Hybrid RAG, pgvector, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), Cohere Rerank, OpenAI Realtime API, LiveKit WebRTC, Gemini LLM.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Git/GitHub Actions, Postman, Vercel, Render, AWS EC2.

## Key Projects
1. **TRIAM - Ebook with Agent Assistant**: High-performance backend with Flutter mobile client, LiveKit WebRTC audio streaming, and Hybrid RAG.
2. **SinooHub - Fullstack Portfolio Platform**: Monorepo platform featuring JSONB resume management, live preview, version control, and A4 print export.
3. **SafeNews - AI-Powered News Aggregator**: Automated RSS crawler pipeline with Gemini LLM content moderation and sentiment analysis.
